title: Scott and Rohnda’s Resort & Campgrounds

services.name: Cabin Rentals
services.desc: The cabins originally constructed in the chalet style and all have use of the lakes. The kitchen and living area are combined in one large open space on the main floor, along with the master bedroom (one queen bed) and a second bedroom with four single bunks. All cabins boast a second-floor loft with at least one queen and two single beds. Kitchens are fully stocked with propane stoves, fridges and all amenities. All cabins have decks for outdoor living and overlooked the playground, which is your access to the lake and swimming area. All decks have been built to maximize seating. We do ask that visitors bring their own bedding including linens, pillows and sleeping bags as well as towels

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: This pristine hunting area is located in District 13, as stated in the Ontario Hunting Regulation Guide. This area has be known for being one of the best places to hunt moose. You can also find a large population White Tail Deer here too. There are literally hundreds of old logging roads, starting within a mile of the resort. All cabins are easily accessible with trucks pulling quad trailers, etc. Scott Gibson is an advent moose hunt for 30+ years. He has done a lot of moose hunt guiding for both local and international clients. Scott also has a large pole barn located in a shady area to hang animals after harvesting
